actions.add_followup_instruction.descrip: Adds follow-up instructions to a running cloud agent
actions.add_followup_instruction.props.i: Optional images to include with the instruction (max 5)
actions.add_followup_instruction.props.t: The follow-up instruction text for the agent
actions.delete_agent.description: Delete a cloud agent. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
actions.find_agent_status.description: Retrieve the current status and results of a cloud agent
actions.launch_agent.description: Start a new cloud agent to work on your repository
Automatically create a pull request when the agent completes
actions.launch_agent.props.branchName.de: Custom branch name for the agent to create
actions.launch_agent.props.images.descri: Optional images to include with the prompt (max 5)
actions.launch_agent.props.model.descrip: The LLM to use (e.g., claude-4-sonnet). Leave empty to use the default model.
actions.launch_agent.props.openAsCursorG: Open the pull request as the Cursor GitHub App instead of as the user. Only applies if auto-create PR is enabled.
actions.launch_agent.props.promptText.de: The instruction text for the agent
actions.launch_agent.props.ref.descripti: Git ref (branch name, tag, or commit hash) to use as the base branch
actions.launch_agent.props.skipReviewerR: Skip adding the user as a reviewer to the pull request. Only applies if auto-create PR is enabled and opened as Cursor GitHub App.
actions.launch_agent.props.webhookSecret: Secret key for webhook payload verification (minimum 32 characters)
actions.launch_agent.props.webhookUrl.de: URL to receive webhook notifications about agent status changes
auth.description:
User API Keys provide secure, programmatic access to your Cursor account, including the Cloud Agent API.

To get your API Key:
1. Go to cursor.com/dashboard?tab=cloud-agents
2. Scroll to the "User API Keys" section
3. Click "+ New API Key"
4. Copy the generated key (format: key_...)

Treat your API key like a password: keep it secure and never share it publicly.
Note: The Cloud Agent API is in beta.
description: AI-powered code editor with cloud agents that can work on your repositories. Launch agents, monitor their status, and automate code-related tasks.
triggers.agent_pull_request_created.desc: Triggers when a background agent creates a pull request
triggers.agent_status_changed_webhook.de: Triggers when an agent status changes (ERROR or FINISHED). Configure this webhook URL when launching an agent.
triggers.agent_status_changed_webhook.pr: Optional webhook secret for signature verification. Must match the secret used when launching the agent.
triggers.agent_status_equals.description: Triggers when a Cursor agent has the specified status (e.g., "FINISHED", "FAILED")
